## 升级前请阅读 / Before upgrading

- 从数据库谱系不兼容的旧版本跨代升级前，请备份或导出重要数据；应用沿用既有的数据集重建规则，不转换历史数据，Agent 数据清理保留非 Agent 配置。使用已退役 Computer 契约的会话需新建会话，原历史保留，个人 Agent 请重新选择 Computer 动作。
- Back up or export important data before upgrading from an incompatible older database lineage. Existing dataset rebuild rules remain in effect without converting historical data; Agent clean cuts preserve non-Agent configuration. Retired Computer bindings require a new session and reselected actions for personal Agents; existing history is retained.

## 更新内容

- 新增飞书远程知识库：仅凭基本信息即可创建，详情页可维护精选集合，创建时允许空集合。
- 飞书工作台并入知识与连接器：统一文档发现与导航，文档通过原生 CLI 块编辑，标题去重并配备保存提示；工作台移除日历与任务。
- 精简 Office 页面、重设计账号连接、将 Office 入口移至服务，并加入应用切换占位。
- 连接页设备标签更名为 WebUI 并开放能力项。
- 恢复 icon-park 基础样式，使图标在 Arco 按钮内居中；Office 头部动作图标保持单行对齐。

## Highlights

- Add Feishu remote-backed knowledge bases: create bases from basic info only, curate the base set from the detail page, and allow an empty curated set on creation.
- Merge the Feishu workbench into knowledge and connectors: unified document discovery and navigation, documents edit through native CLI blocks with deduplicated titles and save toasts, and Calendar & tasks leave the workbench.
- Simplify office pages, redesign the account connection, move the office entry to services, and add application switcher placeholders.
- Rename connection device tabs to WebUI and open capabilities.
- Restore icon-park base styles so icons center inside Arco buttons, and keep office header action icons on one line.

## Windows 下载 / Downloads

- x64 安装包 / x64 installer: `NomiFun_0.8.17_x64-setup.exe`
- 本次首发仅提供 Windows x64；其他平台产物后续追加。
- This initial publication provides Windows x64 only; other platform artifacts will follow.
